div.div: شَاقٍ A long prominence, or projecting portion, or ledge, (حَيْدٌ طَالِعٌ طَوِيلٌ,) of a mountain, (K, TA,) that cannot be ascended: (TA:) by rule it should be with ء [i. e. شَاقِئٌ, as being derived from شَقَأَ]: (Sgh, TA:) pl. شَوَاقِى (K [correctly شَوَاقٍ]) and شُقْيَانٌ. (TA. [Mentioned in the K in art. شقو, but belonging to the present art.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
